title: The Aerial Parliament Where Leaves Vote on Meaning

features.name: the-parliament-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: You see a layered arch of branches, each curve a row of voteless citizens, each citizen a single rustling voice. The arch frames nothing but grey sky and the sense of waiting consensus.

features.name: the-scattering-meanings
features.desc-on-touch: Seeds of meaning spiral outward from a central point, each seed a different weight, a different colour. None settles. All are still in mid-fall.

features.name: the-audible-tally
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of still air, reflecting nothing, holds text that reads itself backward. When you finish reading it forward, it has changed meaning.

features.name: the-vote-already-cast
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph of unreadable script stands permanent, surrounded by erasure. The leaves have voted. The decision was made before the parliament began.

inscription: the forest learned to argue with itself, and called it parliament

file.name: Parliament_Consensus_Fragmentary.txt
file.note: Records of seventeen votes cast simultaneously by branches that could not see each other. Checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable.

exits.label: downward to the circuit-canopy where branches first spoke
higher still, where meaning learns to refuse consensus
westward along a branch to an older parliament still speaking
